pages.title: Bruder Fliegl barrel tanker
pages.description: Upgrade playtime with the Bruder Fliegl Barrel Tanker, a detailed and durable farming toy.
pages.ld_description:
The new barrel tanker from Fliegl expands BRUDER’s agricultural range to include the latest fertiliser technology. This detailed model from BRUDER is equipped with a towing hose distributor. The integrated tank can be filled with water and closed with a cap. The tanker is emptied through an outlet valve at the rear of the tanker. For road transport, the towing hose distributor can be folded in and folded out again in field operation. The BRUDER 3000 and 4000 series tractors are the perfect tractor for this impressive tanker.

	Fold-out spread tubes
